column1: # Japanese (ja) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation. It covers the
# whole interface (the same entries as `es.tsv`); a string without an entry is shown in English.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Japanese computing and video-editing vocabulary (クリップ, シーケンス, トラック, 再生ヘッド, ぼかし ...). No
# proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries
# the same way. Product and technology names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS ...) keep
# House style, so new entries read like the rest:
#   - Menu commands and buttons are short noun phrases or "〜を + verb" with no する/します ending
#     (別名で保存…, 編集点を追加). Tooltips and messages are です・ます sentences ending in 。
#   - One half-width space between Japanese text and an adjacent Latin word, number or {placeholder}
#     (Lumetri カラー, {n} 個). Half-width ":" and "( )", full-width "？". Always "…", never "...".
#   - The long vowel mark is kept (フォルダー, モニター). Terms: 既定 (not デフォルト), リセット, エフェクト
#     (not 効果), ぼかし, 音量, ビデオ, 再生ヘッド, イン点/アウト点.
#   - "Horizontal"/"Vertical" are 水平/垂直 (guides, blur, axes); vertical text is "Vertical Text".
